exams.notes: Written examination; may be contracted to a nationally recognized testing agency. Director may not limit the number of times a person may take the examination.
exams.jurisdiction: state (department of labor and industries), may contract with nationally recognized testing agency
exams.quote: The director may not limit the number of times that a person may take the examination.

exams.quote: The department shall certify the results of the examinations provided by this chapter, and shall notify the applicant in writing whether he or she has passed or failed.

exams.name: Certificate of Competency Examination (Residential Service Plumber)
exams.notes: Written examination prepared by department with advice of advisory board.
exams.quote: The department, with the advice of the advisory board, shall prepare a written examination to be administered to applicants for certificates of competency for journey level plumber, specialty plumber, and residential service plumber.

available.quote: The director may, upon payment of the appropriate fees, grant a certificate of competency without examination to any applicant who is a registered journey level plumber or specialty plumber in any other state whose requirements for registration are at least substantially equivalent to the requirements of this state, and which extends the same privileges of reciprocity to journey level plumbers or specialty plumbers registered in this state.

exists.quote: There is created a state advisory board of plumbers, to be composed of nine members appointed by the director.

name.quote: "Advisory board" means the state advisory board of plumbers.

authority.value: The advisory board carries out functions and duties enumerated in the chapter, advises the department on enforcement matters including plumbing industry promotion, standards of plumbing installations, consumer protection, and standards for the protection of public health; the board also conducts hearings on certificate revocations and renders decisions thereon.
authority.quote: The advisory board shall carry out all the functions and duties enumerated in this chapter, as well as generally advise the department on all matters relative to the enforcement of this chapter including plumbing industry promotion, standards of plumbing installations, consumer protection, and standards for the protection of public health.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The certificate, license, or endorsement was obtained through error or fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The certificate, license, or endorsement was obtained through error or fraud;

disciplinary_grounds.description: The holder is judged to be incompetent to carry on the trade of plumbing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The certificate, license, or endorsement holder is judged to be incompetent to carry on the trade of plumbing as a journey level plumber, specialty plumber, or residential service plumber;

disciplinary_grounds.description: The holder has violated any provision of this chapter or any rule adopted under this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The certificate, license, or endorsement holder has violated any provision of this chapter or any rule adopted under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A false statement as to a material matter in the application for a certificate, license, or endorsement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A false statement as to a material matter in the application for a certificate, license, or endorsement;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, misrepresentation, or bribery in securing a certificate, license, or endorsement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, misrepresentation, or bribery in securing a certificate, license, or endorsement;

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation of any provision of this chapter (contractor context).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of any provision of this chapter; or

disciplinary_grounds.description: The plumbing contractor does not employ a full-time individual who currently possesses a valid journey level or specialty plumber's certificate of competency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the plumbing contractor does not employ a full-time individual who currently possesses a valid journey level plumber's certificate of competency or specialty plumber's certificate of competency in the specialty for the scope of work performed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The department may deny renewal if the applicant owes outstanding penalties for a final judgment under this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The department may deny renewal of a certificate of competency, license, or endorsement issued under this chapter if the applicant owes outstanding penalties for a final judgment under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certificate must be immediately suspended if holder is certified by DSHS as not in compliance with a support order.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The department shall immediately suspend any certificate of competency issued under this chapter if the holder of the certificate has been certified pursuant to RCW 74.20A.320 by the department of social and health services as a person who is not in compliance with a support order

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any individual or plumbing contractor who acquires three infractions within a thirty-six month period may have their credential suspended for up to two years.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any individual or plumbing contractor who acquires three infractions within a thirty-six month period may have his or her certificate, license, endorsement, or registration suspended for a period of up to two years upon recommendation of the advisory board of plumbers.

bonding_required.quote: Each applicant for a plumbing contractor license shall file with the department a surety bond issued by a surety insurer who meets the requirements of chapter 48.28 RCW in the sum of six thousand dollars.

insurance_required.quote: At the time of plumbing contractor licensing and subsequent license renewal, the applicant shall furnish insurance or financial responsibility in the form of an assigned account in the amount of fifty thousand dollars for injury or damages to property, and one hundred thousand dollars for injury or damage including death to any one person, and two hundred thousand dollars for injury or damage including death to more than one person.

definition_quote.value: "Plumbing" means that craft involved in installing, altering, repairing and renovating potable water systems, liquid waste systems, and medical gas piping systems within a building as defined by the plumbing code as adopted and amended by the state building code council, and includes all piping, fixtures, pumps, and plumbing appurtenances that are used for rainwater catchment and reclaimed water systems within a building.

residential_building_unit_cap.quote: "Residential structures" means single-family dwellings, duplexes, and multiunit buildings that do not exceed three stories.

apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: Trainee supervision shall consist of a trainee under the control of either a journey level plumber, residential service plumber, or an appropriate specialty plumber who has an applicable certificate of competency issued under this chapter.
